prometheus_config.reason: localhost targets would resolve inside a separate Prometheus container, while the VPS compose defines no colocated Prometheus, Alertmanager, Flower, PostgreSQL exporter, Redis exporter or node exporter services.

conditional_execution_contract.name: prove_existing_external_source
conditional_execution_contract.exit_check: The governed HTTPS query origin answers the exact six approved PromQL queries, proves uninterrupted retention from the recorded window start, has stable time synchronization and can export a secret-free candidate-bound snapshot.

conditional_execution_contract.name: activate_bounded_repository_collector_remediation_if_needed
conditional_execution_contract.entry_condition: Phase 1 proves no acceptable retained external source exists and governance assigns one explicit repository execution_focus unit.
conditional_execution_contract.required_repository_outcome: Add a pinned Prometheus-compatible service, persistent volume, retention policy, healthcheck and non-public or approved query access; change the Django scrape target from localhost to a network-reachable service or approved HTTPS exporter; include only deployed scrape jobs; validate alerts and exact M5 queries.

conditional_execution_contract.name: deploy_and_verify_monitoring
conditional_execution_contract.exit_check: The pinned monitoring service is healthy, target up=1, storage and retention are active, exact M5 recording rules load, query access is bounded, and application health/readiness remain unchanged.

conditional_execution_contract.name: redeploy_or_reattest_candidate_then_reset_observation
conditional_execution_contract.reason: The canonical observation start tool derives released_at from a fresh deployment verification and forbids manual date backfill.
conditional_execution_contract.exit_check: A fresh candidate deployment preflight is committed, start_web_to_tui_observation writes a new exact 14-day window, and all candidate-bound evidence that cannot carry forward is cleared by the canonical tool.

conditional_execution_contract.name: collect_full_window_and_build_final_evidence
conditional_execution_contract.exit_check: After the new window end, a reviewed Prometheus snapshot covers all six query keys and 101 tasks and the defect snapshot covers the exact window; both builders and readiness checker remain fail-closed.

impact_and_stop_conditions.expected_impact_if_new_store_is_authoriz: A new monitoring container, persistent volume, scrape traffic, disk growth and a fresh candidate observation window; no business database mutation is required by the collector itself.

rollback_contract.monitoring_service: Restore the prior compose/config release and stop the new monitoring service under separate authorization; retain the monitoring volume and logs for evidence until the owner approves disposal.
rollback_contract.application_candidate: Use the existing candidate deployment rollback contract if the re-attested deployment affects application health; do not alter production database state solely to remove monitoring.
rollback_contract.observation_evidence: Keep the current window denied and supersede it only through the canonical observation-start tool. Never edit dates or copy forward telemetry, defects, backup attestations or approvals.

next_action: Operations chooses and supplies an existing retained Prometheus source or authorizes a bounded repository plus production monitoring remediation. No collector implementation or deployment may begin while execution_focus remains null and the required inputs are empty.
